title_en: The Expected Mahdi in the Words of Muhyiddin Ibn Arabi - Episode 2
description_en: The Expected Mahdi (peace be upon him) in the Words of Muhyiddin Ibn Arabi - Episode 2, an episode of the Al-Utruha al-Mahdiyya program by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: An episode examining what the mystic Muhyiddin Ibn Arabi stated regarding the expected Mahdi.
